stem: Which statement describes how President Reagan's economic policies intended to stimulate job growth?

options.label: A
options.text: Tax cuts were meant to increase the volume of foreign trade.

options.label: B
options.text: Tax cuts were meant to increase the availability of foreign business loans.

options.label: C
options.text: Tax cuts were meant to increase government spending.

options.label: D
options.text: Tax cuts were meant to increase investment by business owners.

visual_elements: This time around, tax reduction should be preferred to spending increases. Furthermore, tax reductions should be aimed at creating incentives to save and invest, or to work harder, rather than to spend more. We need to increase the supply of savings. We need to increase the supply of plant and equipment. We need to increase the supply of skilled manpower, and we need to increase the supply of goods on the shelves—not just to increase the demand for them. —Hon. Clarence J. Brown, U.S. Congress, May 21, 1980
